desc:
🏷️ Start with one table. End with a billion-dollar brand!

Pick your products (clothes, sneakers, jewelry, makeup or tech), design your logo and open your shop!

🛠️ Make products with fun mini-games
💰 Sell to customers and earn billions
👷 Hire staff to run your shop for you
🏢 Build your HQ into a giant skyscraper
🛸 Fly around on your own giant products
🌍 Go Global to Tokyo, Paris and New York

🎁 A new gift every day!

Can you build the biggest brand in the world? 👑
